Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 12099-1987 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 

TRIANGULAR POLISHING BLOCKS FOR THE USE 

IN FLOOR POLISHING MACHINES 



CO 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements of triangular polishing blocks suitable for floor polishing 
machines conforming to IS : 3365-1965 ' Specification for floor polishing machines '. 



2. Grades — Shall be as given below: 

Grade 
Coarse 
Medium 
Fine 



Grit Size 
36-46 
54-60 
80-100 



3. Dimensions 



All dimensions in millimetres. 



50 



R16 



(t)20 



75 

1 

30 

" 1 


60° ^ 


60 




80 



4. Material —The triangular polishing blocks shall be made from black silicon carbide grains. 

5. Designation — Triangular polishing blocks shall be designated by its commonly used name, 
material, grit size of the abrasive and number of the standard. 

Example: Triangular polishing block made from silicon carbide (C) grains of grit size 60 shall 
be designated as: 

Triangular Polishing Block C 60 IS : 12099 



Adopted 8 July 1987 



O March 1988. BIS 



Gr 1 



BUREAU OF INDIAN STANDARDS 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW DELHI 110002 



IS : 12099 - 1987 

6. Marking — The triangular polishing blocks shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, i&tials 
or trade- mark, grade and grit size. "
